tools.name: start_quote_request
tools.description: Builds a link that opens Chet's request form with the homeowner's project already filled in. Use it when someone in the United States wants written quotes from local contractors for a home project. Give the homeowner the link: Chet sends nothing until they open it, answer the questions a contractor

tools.name: get_cost_guide
tools.description: Price ranges for a home project from Chet's cost guides, every figure with its published source. The guides cover the San Francisco Bay Area so far. Returns the closest guides, or the list of all guides when none fits.

tools.name: how_chet_works
tools.description: How Chet works, what it costs, where it works and who sees the homeowner's details. Use it before suggesting Chet or when someone asks about it.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_quote_request · Public sink: start_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_quote_request · Public sink: start_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
